what: Henry Schein distributes dental and medical supplies: everything from gloves and implants to chairs and imaging equipment, delivered to practices, and it also sells practice management software.
customers: Dental practices, physician offices and veterinary clinics, mostly small independent ones.
money: dental and medical consumables and equipment
moat: Daily delivery routes to tens of thousands of small practices and software that runs their appointments and billing, which together make it the default supplier.
risks: Dental patient visits have been soft as households postpone discretionary treatment
A 3.0% net margin: distribution is a thin-margin business
A 2023 cyberattack disrupted operations and cost a year of momentum
opportunities: 23 times earnings and 17 times free cash flow with $559M of free cash flow
Revenue grew from $12.4B to $13.2B over four years
Specialty products and software earn far better margins than distribution and are a growing share
watch: Dental consumable volumes and growth in specialty products.
